housing.summary: Numbeo reported PLN 3,584.38 per month for a one-bedroom apartment in Kraków city centre, last updated 25 August 2026: https://www.numbeo.com/cost-of-living/in/Krakow-Cracow. EURES says a Polish rental deposit usually equals one monthly rent: https://eures.europa.eu/living-and-working/living-and-working-conditions-europe/living-and-working-conditions-poland_en. Kraków's official guide for foreigners identifies Otodom and OLX as popular apartment-search sites: https://otwarty.krakow.pl/zalacznik/473210. Live Kraków rental listings are available at https://www.otodom.pl/pl/oferty/wynajem/mieszkanie/krakow.

banking.summary: PKO Bank Polski's official account-opening page says a branch applicant needs an identity document (ID card or passport). It also lists PESEL, a Polish mobile number, email and residence/mailing addresses among the required data, and a foreign tax identification number when the applicant is a taxpayer of another country: https://www.pkobp.pl/en/how-to-open-a-personal-account.
required_docs: valid identity document (ID card or passport)
foreign tax identification number if the applicant is a taxpayer of another country

schools.summary: The 2026 WhereNext Kraków international-schools directory lists British, International Baccalaureate, Canadian and American curricula among the city's schools: https://getwherenext.com/schools/krakow/insights.

legal_admin.summary: A foreigner living in Poland must register permanent residence, or temporary residence when staying at an address for more than three months, no later than the 30th day of residence; registration is handled by the municipality office where the person lives: https://www.gov.pl/web/gov/zamelduj-sie-na-pobyt-staly-dla-cudzoziemcow-en.
legal_admin.registration_step: Register the Kraków address as permanent residence, or as temporary residence for a stay over three months, with the municipality office no later than the 30th day of residence.

tax_finance.summary: Poland's Ministry of Finance says a foreign national settling tax in Poland should generally use PESEL; NIP applies to people conducting business, registered for VAT or acting as tax or social/health-insurance payers: https://www.podatki.gov.pl/twoj-e-pit/en-pit-36-za-2025-rok. A foreigner receives PESEL automatically after registering residence for over 30 days; if unable to register but an office requires PESEL, apply in person at any municipality office with the legal basis and identity document: https://www.gov.pl/web/gov/uzyskaj-numer-pesel--usluga-dla-cudzoziemcow-en.
tax_finance.tax_id_name: PESEL (or NIP for business, VAT-registered taxpayers and tax or insurance payers)

transport.summary: The Public Transport Authority organizes Public Transport in Kraków (KMK): https://ztp.krakow.pl/en/kmk-public-transport/kmk-organizer-and-operators. The official tariff effective 2 March 2026 lists a full-fare monthly personalized resident network ticket for zone I at PLN 99: https://ztp.krakow.pl/wszystkie-aktualnosci/kmk/taryfa-biletowa-od-2-marca-wszystkie-dostepne-bilety.html. A valid EU licence remains valid without exchange; otherwise a foreign licence holder living in Poland for at least 185 days should exchange it, and a licence outside the Geneva/Vienna Convention models requires the state theory exam: https://www.gov.pl/web/gov/wymien-zagraniczne-prawo-jazdy-na-polskie. A resident not covered by mandatory health insurance can apply for voluntary NFZ insurance at the competent regional branch, sign the agreement, then submit ZUS ZZA and, for covered family members, ZUS ZCNA: https://www.nfz.gov.pl/dla-pacjenta/ubezpieczenia-w-nfz/jak-sie-ubezpieczyc-dobrowolnie.
transport.driving_licence_exchange: Valid EU licences do not need exchange. Other foreign licence holders living in Poland for at least 185 days should exchange; licences outside Geneva/Vienna Convention models require the state theory exam.
transport.healthcare_registration: If not covered by mandatory insurance, apply to the competent regional NFZ branch for voluntary insurance, sign the agreement, then register with ZUS on form ZUS ZZA (and ZUS ZCNA for family members).
